title: Recording a Passed Vehicle Inspection on a Wayfare Driver Agreement: Tool Reference
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing: vehicle inspections.**

An inspection upload carries no expiry date of its own: support records it, and the vehicle inspection expiry date on the agreement becomes the inspection date plus the inspection validity days. The inspection validity days are the calendar days, counted from the inspection date, for which a passed vehicle inspection uploaded to the standing record counts as the vehicle inspection on file.

## Applicable situation

- **The inspection:** the latest vehicle inspection upload on the driver's standing record; the inspection date is the date of that upload entry.
- **Who records it:** support. Until it is recorded, the vehicle inspection expiry date on the agreement stays as it was.
- **Levels:** all six Wayfare driver levels.

## Recording tool

The inspection is recorded with the agent tool `record_inspection_validity_ad704ee2`, a hidden tool that the agent unlocks and then calls.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `driver_agreement_id` | the reference number of the driver services agreement whose inspection is being recorded, as returned by the driver agreement lookup | identifier, as shown |
| `inspection_date` | the date the inspection was passed, copied exactly as the standing record lookup shows it on the inspection upload | `YYYY-MM-DD`, a calendar date, no time of day |
| `validity_days` | the inspection's validity | a whole number of calendar days counted from `inspection_date`: integer, no decimals, no unit text |

One call sets the agreement's vehicle inspection expiry date on file to `inspection_date` advanced by `validity_days` calendar days; nothing else on the agreement changes.

## Receipt

The tool returns a dictionary receipt with `driver_agreement_id`, `inspection_expiry_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, the inspection expiry date now on file) and `inspection_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, as given). A receipt carrying the new `inspection_expiry_date` means the inspection is recorded, and it counts as on file and unexpired through that date. The tool's contract defines no other outcome.

Hypothetical illustration: an `inspection_date` of `2026-03-02` with `validity_days` of `200` returns an `inspection_expiry_date` of `2026-09-18`.
